newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU jobless rate unchanged at 10.9 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: EU jobless rate unchanged at 10.9 pct in March.

text.p: Unemployment in the European Union was unchanged at 10.9 percent in March, with 18.3 million people out of work, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, said on Friday.
Following revisions, the latest result is the same as in the prior three months.
Among the EU's 15 nations, joblessness over the past few months continued to rise in Sweden and Germany but declined in Britain and the Netherlands.
Elsewhere the jobless rate was "fairly stable", Eurostat said.
Spain had by far the highest level of unemployment at 21.4 percent while Luxembourg -- based on February figures -- retained the lowest rate at 3.6 percent.
